svg.title: G-04 - Hull lines plan
svg.text: Mid-body: parallel, 26 m beam, identical on all decks so the stair towers stack.
Deck 1 nose reaches furthest forward (bridge overhangs the bow);
Deck 3 reaches furthest aft (hangar forms a stern platform).
HALF-BREADTH PLAN - THREE DECK OUTLINES SUPERIMPOSED
